metadata.title: Set up your child
metadata.description: A few quick steps: your child’s profile, a companion, and the settings you want.

guide.welcome: Hi! I am Hort. I will show you around.
guide.child: Who are we helping? Just a first name is fine.
guide.interests: What does your child love? I will pick matching examples.
guide.tutor: Every companion helps in their own way. Take your time.
guide.alexa: Alexa is optional. Skip it if you like.
guide.controls: You decide. Everything here can stay private.
guide.done: All set! Time for the first homework.

welcome.title: Let’s set things up together
welcome.description: It takes about three minutes. Everything is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back.

child.title: Add your child
child.description: A first name, the federal state and the grade, so Hort fits the school curriculum.

companion.title: Choose a companion
companion.description: Pick interests and the friend who will help with homework.

controls.title: Set your safety rules
controls.description: Voice, learning times and what Hort may note. You stay in control.

welcome.promise: Hort never gives the solution. Your child still does the thinking.

child.title: Tell us about your child
child.description: Hort uses this to match the school curriculum of your child’s grade.
child.displayName: What should Hort call your child?
child.displayNameHint: A first name or nickname is enough. Please no surname.
child.federalStateHint: The curriculum is different in every state.
child.privacy: Only you can see this profile. Your child does not need an account.

interests.title: What does {name} enjoy?
interests.description: Choose up to {max}. Hort uses them to pick examples your child likes. You can skip this.
interests.limitReached: That is the maximum. Remove one to choose another.

tutor.title: Who should help {name}?
tutor.description: Every companion has their own voice and way of explaining. You can change this later.
tutor.languageNote: Companions speak German with your child, so their words below are in German.
tutor.audioUnavailable: The introduction is not available right now. You can still choose this companion.
tutor.pick: Tap a companion to meet them.

alexa.title: Connect Alexa (optional)
alexa.description: Later, your child can start Hort by voice through Alexa. You can disconnect it at any time.
alexa.unavailableNote: Connecting Alexa is still being built. Nothing is stored here, and the setup works without it.
alexa.linkedNote: Alexa is connected to this account.

controls.title: Safety and settings
controls.description: You decide what {name} may do. The safest choice is already selected.

voice.title: Talking to Hort
voice.description: {name} may speak to Hort and hear Hort answer. Typing always works. Alexa cannot be connected yet.

time.title: Learning time
time.description: Keep homework help to times that suit your family.
time.windowDescription: Hort is only available inside this window.
time.note: Times apply from the first homework help. The daily limit is saved now and applied once Hort can measure learning time.

insights.title: Notes for your summary
insights.description: Hort may note which kinds of tasks {name} needed help with, for your summary later. No chats are kept. The summary is still being built.

always.title: Always on, you cannot turn these off

items.solution: Hort never gives the solution to a task. Your child does the thinking.
items.checks: Text for your child goes through safety checks first.
items.private: Only you can see this profile. Your child has no account.

guardian.label: I am the parent or legal guardian of {name}, and I allow Hort to store the details from this setup.
guardian.hint: Required to continue. Privacy notice version {version}.

review.title: Is everything right?
review.description: Have a last look. You can change anything now.

done.title: {name} is ready!
done.description: Whenever there is homework, {tutor} will think it through together with {name}.

reset.label: Reset setup (dev only)
reset.hint: Development only: deletes your child profiles so you can run the setup again.

errors.notFound: We could not find this profile. Please go back one step and try again.
errors.alreadyOnboarded: Your child is already set up. Taking you to your home.
errors.setupIncomplete: A step is still missing. Please go through the steps once more.
errors.devResetUnavailable: This is only available while developing.
errors.infrastructure: We could not save that right now. Nothing was changed. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: We could not confirm that this was saved. Please try again.

validation.displayNameRequired: Please enter a name for your child.
validation.displayNameTooLong: The name can have at most {displayNameMax} characters.
validation.displayNameInvalid: Please use letters, numbers or simple punctuation only.
validation.interestsInvalid: One of the interests is not available.
validation.dailyLimitInvalid: Please choose one of the listed limits.
validation.windowInvalid: The window must end at least 30 minutes after it starts.
validation.guardianConfirmationRequired: Please confirm that you are the parent or guardian.
